sentences.en: I don't think Friday is feasible anymore.
I was wondering if we could push back the release to next Wednesday.
That sounds like a reasonable trade-off.
I wanted to flag something about the project timeline.
I was wondering if we could push back the deadline by two days.
We could reduce the scope and deliver the most important part first.
Thanks for being flexible. I'll keep you updated.
I was wondering if you could review my slides before the meeting.
sentences.zh: 不知道你能不能在開會前幫我看一下簡報。

sentences.en: Would it be possible to move our call to 3 p.m.?
sentences.zh: 我們的通話可以改到下午三點嗎？

sentences.en: Would you mind sending me the latest version?
sentences.zh: 可以麻煩你把最新版本寄給我嗎？

sentences.en: I'd like to flag an issue first: this timeline might not be feasible.
sentences.zh: 我想先提出一個問題：這個時程可能不太可行。

sentences.en: If we reduce the scope, we can still launch on Friday.
sentences.zh: 如果我們縮小範圍，週五還是可以上線。

sentences.en: I was wondering if we could push back the meeting to next Monday.
sentences.zh: 不知道我們能不能把會議延到下週一？

sentences.en: We could, but something has to give.
That way nothing that's already been promised slips.
I'd just rather not commit to a date until we've scoped it properly.
We've finished the search page, and we reached the testing milestone on Wednesday.
Their legal team hasn't signed off on the contract yet.
I emailed them on Monday and called yesterday.
Overall, the project is on track for the end of the month.
We've finished the search page, and testing started on Wednesday.
Our main blocker is that legal hasn't signed off on the contract yet.
I'll follow up with them on Thursday and keep you posted.
We've completed three of the five milestones so far.
sentences.zh: 到目前為止我們完成了五個里程碑中的三個。

sentences.en: We completed the second milestone last Thursday.
sentences.zh: 我們上週四完成了第二個里程碑。

sentences.en: Has the client signed off on the design yet?
sentences.zh: 客戶核准設計了沒？

sentences.en: Overall, the project is still on track.
sentences.zh: 整體來說，這個專案仍按計畫進行。

sentences.en: We've finished the payment flow.
sentences.zh: 我們已經完成了付款流程。

sentences.en: We rolled out the new version last Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 我們上週二推出了新版本。

sentences.en: Legal hasn't signed off on the contract yet, and that's our biggest blocker right now.
sentences.zh: 法務還沒核准合約，這是我們目前最大的卡關點。

sentences.en: The refund pages will carry over to next week, and I'll follow up with the vendor again tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 退款頁面會順延到下週，我明天會再跟供應商追蹤。

sentences.en: I'd honestly rather hear about the bumps.
We've only got a four-hour window on launch night.
Priya's been carrying this on her own.
I've been having this pain in my lower back.
Have you been taking anything for it?
Then come back in two weeks and I'll write you a referral to a physical therapist.
I've been feeling run-down for the past couple of weeks.
It usually flares up in the afternoon.
I've been taking an over-the-counter painkiller, but it doesn't really help.
Is there anything I should avoid while I'm on this prescription?
I've been sleeping badly since the project started.
sentences.zh: 從專案開始以來，我一直睡不好。

sentences.en: She's been taking this medicine for two weeks, and she hasn't had any side effects.
sentences.zh: 她吃這個藥兩週了，沒有任何副作用。

sentences.en: Your eyes look red. Have you been staring at a screen all day?
sentences.zh: 你眼睛好紅，是不是盯著螢幕一整天？

sentences.en: I've been sleeping badly for the past two weeks.
sentences.zh: 我這兩個禮拜一直睡不好。

sentences.en: Does this medicine have any side effects?
sentences.zh: 這個藥有副作用嗎？

sentences.en: If it still doesn't get better, I'll give you a referral.
sentences.zh: 如果還是沒好，我會幫你轉診。

sentences.en: I've been waking up two, three times.
Everyone's been coming down with something since the conference.
I'd like to rule out a chest infection before we jump to conclusions.
Do we have a ballpark date for the dashboard?
Why don't we ask Lena to join as a second designer for the first month?
Let's do a fifteen-minute check-in every Tuesday, and a longer review at each milestone.
Before we kick off, let's agree on the main deliverables.
Why don't we touch base again on Friday?
I'd suggest that we name one point of contact for each team.
If we keep it simple, we can hit the ground running.
Why don't we set up a quick call with the client before we finalize the timeline?
sentences.zh: 我們何不在確定時程前，先跟客戶開個簡短的電話會議？

sentences.en: I'd suggest that each team name one point of contact.
sentences.zh: 我建議每個團隊指定一位窗口。

sentences.en: I'd suggest starting with a smaller pilot and expanding it later.
sentences.zh: 我建議先從小規模試行開始，之後再擴大。

sentences.en: Why don't we have a quick meeting first to clarify the main deliverables?
sentences.zh: 我們何不先開個短會，把主要的交付項目講清楚？

sentences.en: I'd suggest that each department name a point of contact.
sentences.zh: 我建議每個部門指定一位窗口。

sentences.en: We've been preparing for the project kickoff meeting for the past two weeks.
sentences.zh: 這兩個禮拜我們一直在準備專案啟動會議。

sentences.en: I'd rather we didn't lock ourselves into a number we can't defend.
Finance likes things in black and white.
He's been dealing with finance all year.
I'm presenting the Q3 numbers to leadership on Tuesday.
In about eight months, as long as we ramp up marketing in the spring.
Support is going to need two more people by summer if this keeps up.
I'm presenting the results to the leadership team next Tuesday.
The key takeaway is that sign-ups are up year-over-year.
I think we'll probably break even by July.
I'm going to raise the headcount issue myself.
We're launching the spring campaign on March 3rd.
sentences.zh: 我們 3 月 3 日推出春季活動。（已經排定）

sentences.en: I'm going to open the presentation with one key takeaway.
sentences.zh: 我打算用一個重點結論開場。（已經決定）

sentences.en: I think the new plan will probably break even by July.
sentences.zh: 我想新方案大概會在七月前打平。（預測）

sentences.en: We're meeting the client next Tuesday. It's already scheduled.
sentences.zh: 我們下週二要跟客戶開會，已經排好了。

sentences.en: I think the new plan will probably break even next summer.
sentences.zh: 我覺得新方案大概會在明年夏天打平。

sentences.en: We launched the new pricing in September, and sign-ups have grown by 18% since then.
sentences.zh: 我們九月推出了新價格，從那之後註冊人數已經成長了 18%。

sentences.en: The board's going to spot it in about five seconds.
The warehouse closure's happening in January, period.
I'll give them a range and stick to it.

grammar.q: I was wondering ___ you could help me with the budget report.
grammar.explain_zh: I was wondering 後面用 if 或 whether 帶出一個子句。
grammar.point: Polite requests: I was wondering if… / Would it be possible to…
grammar.point_zh: 委婉請求：I was wondering if… ／ Would it be possible to…

grammar.q: Would you mind ___ the door? It's a bit noisy outside.
grammar.explain_zh: Would you mind 後面接 V-ing：Would you mind closing…?
grammar.point: Polite requests: I was wondering if… / Would it be possible to…
grammar.point_zh: 委婉請求：I was wondering if… ／ Would it be possible to…

grammar.q: Which request sounds the most polite in an email to a senior manager?
options: I was wondering if we could move the deadline to Friday.
You need to move the deadline.
grammar.explain_zh: I was wondering if we could… 用過去進行式＋could，語氣最委婉。
grammar.point: Polite requests: I was wondering if… / Would it be possible to…
grammar.point_zh: 委婉請求：I was wondering if… ／ Would it be possible to…

grammar.q: Would it be possible ___ (extend) the deadline by two days?
grammar.explain_zh: Would it be possible + to + 原形動詞。
grammar.point: Polite requests: I was wondering if… / Would it be possible to…
grammar.point_zh: 委婉請求：I was wondering if… ／ Would it be possible to…

grammar.q: A colleague asks, "Would you mind if I joined the meeting?" You are happy for them to join. What do you say?
grammar.explain_zh: mind 是「介意」。回答 Not at all（一點也不介意）才是「可以」。
grammar.point: Polite requests: I was wondering if… / Would it be possible to…
grammar.point_zh: 委婉請求：I was wondering if… ／ Would it be possible to…

grammar.q: We ___ the new dashboard to all users last Monday.
grammar.explain_zh: 有明確過去時間 last Monday，要用過去簡單式 rolled out。
grammar.point: Present perfect vs past simple
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成式 vs 過去簡單式

grammar.q: So far this week, we ___ (fix) twelve bugs.
grammar.explain_zh: So far this week（到目前為止）表示期間還沒結束，用現在完成式 have fixed。
grammar.point: Present perfect vs past simple
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成式 vs 過去簡單式

grammar.q: Which sentence is correct?
options: I have sent the report yesterday.
I have send the report yesterday.
grammar.explain_zh: yesterday 是明確過去時間，不能和現在完成式連用，所以是 I sent the report yesterday。
grammar.point: Present perfect vs past simple
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成式 vs 過去簡單式

grammar.q: Legal still ___ (not / sign) off on the contract, so we can't start.
grammar.explain_zh: still … not 表示到現在還沒發生，主詞 Legal 視為單數，用 hasn't signed。
grammar.point: Present perfect vs past simple
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成式 vs 過去簡單式

grammar.q: A: "When did you finish the migration?" B: "We ___ it on Wednesday night."
grammar.explain_zh: 問句用 When did…，問的是過去的時間點，回答也用過去式 finished。
grammar.point: Present perfect vs past simple
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成式 vs 過去簡單式

grammar.q: I ___ (feel) dizzy since I got up this morning.
grammar.explain_zh: since 早上起床到現在都在持續，用 have been + V-ing。
grammar.point: Present perfect continuous for ongoing situations
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成進行式：描述「從過去到現在一直在持續」的狀況

grammar.q: "How long ___ this cough?" the doctor asked.
grammar.explain_zh: How long 問持續到現在的時間，用現在完成進行式。這裡 have 是「出現症狀」的動作意思，可以用進行式；have you had 也可以，但選項中只有 B 正確。
grammar.point: Present perfect continuous for ongoing situations
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成進行式：描述「從過去到現在一直在持續」的狀況

grammar.q: Which sentence is correct?
options: I've been knowing my doctor for ten years.
I've known my doctor for ten years.
I'm knowing my doctor for ten years.
I know my doctor since ten years.
grammar.explain_zh: know 是狀態動詞，不用進行式；持續到現在用現在完成式 have known + for。
grammar.point: Present perfect continuous for ongoing situations
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成進行式：描述「從過去到現在一直在持續」的狀況

grammar.q: My knee ___ (hurt) on and off for a month, so I finally booked an appointment.
grammar.explain_zh: 主詞 My knee 是第三人稱單數，用 has been hurting；for a month 表示持續到現在。
grammar.point: Present perfect continuous for ongoing situations
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成進行式：描述「從過去到現在一直在持續」的狀況

grammar.q: Choose the best answer: "You look exhausted." — "I know. I ___ late every night this week."
grammar.explain_zh: this week 還沒結束，而且「看起來很累」是這陣子持續加班的結果，用現在完成進行式最自然。
grammar.point: Present perfect continuous for ongoing situations
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成進行式：描述「從過去到現在一直在持續」的狀況

grammar.q: Which sentence focuses on HOW MANY, not on the ongoing activity?
options: I've been taking painkillers all week.
grammar.explain_zh: 有具體次數／數量（four painkillers）時用現在完成式 have taken，強調結果；其他三句都在描述持續的狀態或動作。
grammar.point: Present perfect continuous for ongoing situations
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成進行式：描述「從過去到現在一直在持續」的狀況

grammar.q: I ___ the doctor last Tuesday, and she ___ me some eye drops.
grammar.explain_zh: last Tuesday 是明確的過去時間點，兩個動作都已結束，都用過去式。看到明確過去時間（yesterday、last…、ago、in 2024）就用過去式。
grammar.point: Present perfect vs past simple
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成式 vs 過去式

grammar.q: I ___ (never / need) a referral before, so I'm not sure how it works.
grammar.explain_zh: 到目前為止的人生經驗、沒有特定時間點，用現在完成式；never 放在 have 和 p.p. 之間。
grammar.point: Present perfect vs past simple
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成式 vs 過去式

grammar.q: Which sentence is correct?
options: I've had the flu two weeks ago.
I had the flu two weeks ago, but I've felt fine since then.
I had the flu two weeks ago, but I felt fine since then.
I've had the flu two weeks ago, but I felt fine since then.
grammar.explain_zh: two weeks ago 用過去式 had；since then 是「從那時到現在」，用現在完成式 have felt。一句裡兩種時態各管各的時間。
grammar.point: Present perfect vs past simple
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成式 vs 過去式

grammar.q: ___ we split the work into two phases? (提議：我們何不…？)
grammar.explain_zh: Why don't we + 原形動詞？是友善的提議，don't 放在 we 前面（不是 Why we don't）。
grammar.point: Making suggestions: Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…
grammar.point_zh: 提出建議：Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…

grammar.q: I'd suggest that she ___ the client before Friday.
grammar.explain_zh: suggest that 子句的動詞用原形（美式與正式英文的標準用法），主詞是 she 也不加 s，所以是 call。英式英文也常說 calls 或 should call，但本課以美式為準，請用原形。
grammar.point: Making suggestions: Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…
grammar.point_zh: 提出建議：Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…

grammar.q: Which sentence is correct?
options: I suggest you to update the timeline.
I'd suggest to update the timeline.
I suggest you updating the timeline.
grammar.explain_zh: suggest 後面接 V-ing 或 that 子句，不接 to V，也不接「人 + to V」。正確是 I'd suggest updating…
grammar.point: Making suggestions: Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…
grammar.point_zh: 提出建議：Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…

grammar.q: How about ___ (move) the review to Thursday?
grammar.explain_zh: How about / What about 後面接 V-ing。
grammar.point: Making suggestions: Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…
grammar.point_zh: 提出建議：Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…

grammar.q: You're in a meeting with a senior manager from another department. Which suggestion sounds the most polite?
options: We have to change the plan.
I'd suggest that we take another look at the plan.
Why you don't change the plan?
grammar.explain_zh: I'd suggest that we… 語氣委婉又正式；A、B 像命令；D 語序錯誤，應該是 Why don't you…?
grammar.point: Making suggestions: Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…
grammar.point_zh: 提出建議：Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…

grammar.q: I'd suggest that he ___ (touch) base with the design team before the next milestone.
grammar.explain_zh: suggest that 子句用原形動詞，主詞是 he 也不加 s。
grammar.point: Making suggestions: Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…
grammar.point_zh: 提出建議：Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…

grammar.q: We ___ (work) on this proposal since September, and it still isn't finished.
grammar.explain_zh: since September 到現在還在做（still isn't finished），用 have been + V-ing。
grammar.point: Present perfect continuous for ongoing situations
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成進行式：描述「從過去一直持續到現在」的狀況（對照：過去的時間點 → 過去式）

grammar.q: I ___ the report yesterday afternoon, so you should have it already.
grammar.explain_zh: 有明確的過去時間點 yesterday afternoon → 用過去式 finished。時間點用過去式、持續到現在才用完成（進行）式。
grammar.point: Present perfect continuous for ongoing situations
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成進行式：描述「從過去一直持續到現在」的狀況（對照：過去的時間點 → 過去式）

grammar.q: "Sorry I'm late! ___ long?" — "No, just a few minutes."
grammar.explain_zh: 對方從過去等到現在（剛剛還在等），問「你等很久了嗎」用現在完成進行式 Have you been waiting long?
grammar.point: Present perfect continuous for ongoing situations
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成進行式：描述「從過去一直持續到現在」的狀況（對照：過去的時間點 → 過去式）

grammar.q: "The phone's ringing." — "Don't worry, I ___ it."
grammar.explain_zh: 電話剛響、說話當下才決定去接 → 用 will（I'll get it）。going to 是事先就決定好的打算，這裡不自然。
grammar.point: Future forms: will, going to, present continuous for plans
grammar.point_zh: 未來式：will、be going to、現在進行式表示已安排的計畫

grammar.q: Which is the most natural? "I ___ the vendor at 10 tomorrow — it's already on my calendar."
grammar.explain_zh: 已經排進行事曆、有時間的安排 → 現在進行式 I'm meeting。I'll meet 文法上不算錯，但聽起來像當下才決定，最自然的是 'm meeting。
grammar.point: Future forms: will, going to, present continuous for plans
grammar.point_zh: 未來式：will、be going to、現在進行式表示已安排的計畫

grammar.q: Look at these numbers. We ___ (miss) our Q4 target unless something changes.
grammar.explain_zh: 看著眼前的數字（證據）做預測，最常用 be going to：We're going to miss… 主詞 we 要配 are，別漏掉 be 動詞。will miss 也可以接受。
grammar.point: Future forms: will, going to, present continuous for plans
grammar.point_zh: 未來式：will、be going to、現在進行式表示已安排的計畫

grammar.q: I think the new plan ___ even by next summer.
grammar.explain_zh: I think + 一般預測 → will + 原形動詞（will break even）。is breaking 是已排定的安排，「打平」不是能排進行事曆的事；breaks 用現在簡單式講個人預測不自然；is going break 少了 to（要說 is going to break even）。
grammar.point: Future forms: will, going to, present continuous for plans
grammar.point_zh: 未來式：will、be going to、現在進行式表示已安排的計畫

grammar.q: Sorry, I can't make Thursday. I ___ (fly) to Tokyo that morning — the tickets are booked.
grammar.explain_zh: 機票已經訂好、行程確定 → 現在進行式 I'm flying 最自然（be going to fly 也可以）。
grammar.point: Future forms: will, going to, present continuous for plans
grammar.point_zh: 未來式：will、be going to、現在進行式表示已安排的計畫

grammar.q: Which sentence is correct?
options: I'm going to raise the headcount issue myself.
I going to raise the headcount issue myself.
I'm going raise the headcount issue myself.
I will to raise the headcount issue myself.
grammar.explain_zh: be going to + 原形動詞，三個部分都不能少：I'm（be 動詞）＋ going to ＋ raise。will 後面直接接原形，不加 to。
grammar.point: Future forms: will, going to, present continuous for plans
grammar.point_zh: 未來式：will、be going to、現在進行式表示已安排的計畫

grammar.q: Sign-ups ___ (grow) by 18% since we launched the new plan.
grammar.explain_zh: since + 過去時間點，表示「從那時到現在」→ 現在完成式 have grown。主詞 sign-ups 是複數，用 have。
grammar.point: Present perfect vs past simple
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成式 vs 過去簡單式：「到現在」用完成式，「過去某個時間點」用過去式

grammar.q: We ___ the new pricing in September.
grammar.explain_zh: in September 是明確的過去時間點 → 過去式 launched。有時間點就不用完成式。
grammar.point: Present perfect vs past simple
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成式 vs 過去簡單式：「到現在」用完成式，「過去某個時間點」用過去式

grammar.q: I ___ on this team for three years, so I know the numbers well.
grammar.explain_zh: for three years 而且現在還在這個團隊（so I know the numbers well）→ 現在完成式 have worked。用 worked 會變成「以前待過、現在不在了」。
grammar.point: Present perfect vs past simple
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成式 vs 過去簡單式：「到現在」用完成式，「過去某個時間點」用過去式

translate.zh: 不知道你能不能在開會前幫我看一下簡報。
translate.en: I was wondering if you could review my slides before the meeting.

translate.zh: 我們的通話可以改到下午三點嗎？
translate.en: Would it be possible to move our call to 3 p.m.?

translate.zh: 可以麻煩你把最新版本寄給我嗎？
translate.en: Would you mind sending me the latest version?

translate.zh: 我想先提出一個問題：這個時程可能不太可行。
translate.en: I'd like to flag an issue first: this timeline might not be feasible.
alt: I want to flag an issue first: this schedule may not be feasible.

translate.zh: 如果我們縮小範圍，週五還是可以上線。
translate.en: If we reduce the scope, we can still launch on Friday.
alt: If we cut the scope, we can still go live on Friday.

translate.zh: 不知道我們能不能把會議延到下週一？
translate.en: I was wondering if we could push back the meeting to next Monday.
alt: I was wondering if we could push the meeting back to next Monday.

translate.zh: 到目前為止我們完成了五個里程碑中的三個。
translate.en: We've completed three of the five milestones so far.

translate.zh: 我們上週四完成了第二個里程碑。
translate.en: We completed the second milestone last Thursday.

translate.zh: 客戶核准設計了沒？
translate.en: Has the client signed off on the design yet?

translate.zh: 整體來說，這個專案仍按計畫進行。
translate.en: Overall, the project is still on track.
alt: Overall, the project is still on schedule.

translate.zh: 我們已經完成了付款流程。
translate.en: We've finished the payment flow.
alt: We have completed the payment flow.
We've completed the payment flow.

translate.zh: 我們上週二推出了新版本。
translate.en: We rolled out the new version last Tuesday.
alt: We released the new version last Tuesday.

translate.zh: 法務還沒核准合約，這是我們目前最大的卡關點。
translate.en: Legal hasn't signed off on the contract yet, and that's our biggest blocker right now.
alt: Legal hasn't approved the contract yet, which is our biggest blocker at the moment.

translate.zh: 退款頁面會順延到下週，我明天會再跟供應商追蹤。
translate.en: The refund pages will carry over to next week, and I'll follow up with the vendor again tomorrow.
alt: The refund pages will be carried over to next week. I'll follow up with the supplier tomorrow.
The refund pages will carry over to next week, and I'll follow up with the vendor tomorrow.

translate.zh: 從專案開始以來，我一直睡不好。
translate.en: I've been sleeping badly since the project started.

translate.zh: 她吃這個藥兩週了，沒有任何副作用。
translate.en: She's been taking this medicine for two weeks, and she hasn't had any side effects.

translate.zh: 你眼睛好紅，是不是盯著螢幕一整天？
translate.en: Your eyes look red. Have you been staring at a screen all day?

translate.zh: 我這兩個禮拜一直睡不好。
translate.en: I've been sleeping badly for the past two weeks.
alt: I haven't been sleeping well for the past two weeks.
I've been having trouble sleeping for two weeks.

translate.zh: 這個藥有副作用嗎？
translate.en: Does this medicine have any side effects?
alt: Are there any side effects with this medicine?

translate.zh: 如果還是沒好，我會幫你轉診。
translate.en: If it still doesn't get better, I'll give you a referral.
alt: If it doesn't improve, I'll write you a referral.
If it still isn't better, I'll refer you to a specialist.

translate.zh: 我們何不在確定時程前，先跟客戶開個簡短的電話會議？
translate.en: Why don't we set up a quick call with the client before we finalize the timeline?

translate.zh: 我建議每個團隊指定一位窗口。
translate.en: I'd suggest that each team name one point of contact.

translate.zh: 我建議先從小規模試行開始，之後再擴大。
translate.en: I'd suggest starting with a smaller pilot and expanding it later.

translate.zh: 我們何不先開個短會，把主要的交付項目講清楚？
translate.en: Why don't we have a quick meeting first to clarify the main deliverables?
alt: Why don't we start with a short meeting to make the main deliverables clear?
Why don't we have a short meeting first to go over the main deliverables?

translate.zh: 我建議每個部門指定一位窗口。
translate.en: I'd suggest that each department name a point of contact.
alt: I'd suggest that each department choose a point of contact.
I suggest that each department appoint a point of contact.

translate.zh: 這兩個禮拜我們一直在準備專案啟動會議。
translate.en: We've been preparing for the project kickoff meeting for the past two weeks.
alt: For the last two weeks, we've been getting ready for the project kickoff.
We've been preparing for the kickoff meeting for two weeks.

translate.zh: 我們 3 月 3 日推出春季活動。（已經排定）
translate.en: We're launching the spring campaign on March 3rd.

translate.zh: 我打算用一個重點結論開場。（已經決定）
translate.en: I'm going to open the presentation with one key takeaway.

translate.zh: 我想新方案大概會在七月前打平。（預測）
translate.en: I think the new plan will probably break even by July.

translate.zh: 我們下週二要跟客戶開會，已經排好了。
translate.en: We're meeting the client next Tuesday. It's already scheduled.
alt: We're meeting with the client next Tuesday; it's already been scheduled.
We have a meeting with the client next Tuesday. It's already set up.

translate.zh: 我覺得新方案大概會在明年夏天打平。
translate.en: I think the new plan will probably break even next summer.
alt: I think the new plan is probably going to break even next summer.
I think the new plan will probably break even by next summer.

translate.zh: 我們九月推出了新價格，從那之後註冊人數已經成長了 18%。
translate.en: We launched the new pricing in September, and sign-ups have grown by 18% since then.
alt: We launched the new prices in September, and since then sign-ups have gone up 18%.
We introduced the new pricing in September, and sign-ups have increased by 18% since then.
